primaryWitnesses.text: Asa and the people who were with him pursued them to Gerar. So many of the Ethiopians fell that they could not recover themselves, for they were destroyed before the LORD and before his army. Judah’s army carried away very much booty.
primaryWitnesses.previousContext: So the LORD struck the Ethiopians before Asa and before Judah; and the Ethiopians fled.
primaryWitnesses.nextContext: They struck all the cities around Gerar, for the fear of the LORD came on them. They plundered all the cities, for there was much plunder in them.
